confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 for 18 November 2026; I did not open the RBA page myself. I ran one general search for Mendoza prices. It returned mixed-quality and partly dated sources: a mid-range meal of about $15 per person, an inexpensive meal of about $5 to $11, a cappuccino of about EUR 4.12, and an Argentina-wide domestic pint of about $1.79. Argentine peso prices are volatile, so USD figures are uncertain. I ran no further searches. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price relationship (cocktail about 2.5 times beer, wine glass about 2 times beer) rather than from direct data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Mendoza search snippets plus general knowledge of Argentine provincial tourist cities, with Mendoza as a wine-tourism destination priced somewhat above the national average.
